confidence_notes: I did two web searches. The first found the RBA 18 Nov 2026 rate of 1 AUD = 0.6720 USD. That figure came from the search tool's summary of the official RBA exchange rates overview page, not from reading the page directly. The second found few Zhangjiajie-specific food and drink prices. A travel budget guide put a fast-food meal at about 30 CNY and a mid-range meal at about 100 CNY per person, which I used for the two meal anchors. I found no Zhangjiajie-specific prices for cappuccino or beer. Those are based on China-wide crowdsourced averages (cappuccino about $3.07, domestic pint about $1.09) and figures from other small cities (cappuccino $2.00–3.18, beer about $1.20). I raised them for tourist-area pricing in July. I found no direct data for cocktails or wine, so they are estimated from typical Chinese ratios to beer prices and are the least certain food and drink anchors. Accommodation figures are my own estimates from general knowledge for July peak season, not from live listings. Prices near Wulingyuan and the scenic gates can be much higher than in the city centre. I converted local prices to USD at about 7.2 CNY per USD, which is my own assumption, not a searched rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with smaller Chinese tourist cities such as Guilin/Yangshuo and Lijiang, and adjusted using China-wide and small-city crowdsourced averages.
